About Reality Safety & Nets

Thoughtful products.
Reliable service.

We help customers explore window, door and safety solutions for homes and selected commercial spaces. From the first site visit to product selection and installation coordination, our focus is on clear communication, suitable materials and a neat finish.

We are a product and safety-solutions business, not a manufacturer. We help you choose a suitable option based on your opening, usage and requirements.

✳

Our commitment

Quality-focused products and transparent product guidance.

⌂

Customer first

Understand the space before recommending a solution.

Our vision & mission

Built around trust.

Our aim is to make it easier for customers to choose suitable safety and window solutions with confidence.

Our Vision

To become a trusted name for practical home safety and window solutions, recognised for dependable service and customer confidence.

Frequently asked questions

Before you enquire.

We will confirm the right product, exact measurements and applicable specifications for your home or project.

Do you provide a free site visit?

Yes, you can contact us to request a free site visit and discuss measurements and product suitability.

Can I choose the colour and size?

Available colours, mesh, fabric and track options depend on the product. Final measurements are confirmed for your opening.

What is the warranty?

Warranty varies by product and material. Where applicable, the brochure lists up to 5 years for invisible grills and selected bird nets. Please confirm the written terms for your order.

How do I get a quotation?

Choose a product in the enquiry form, share your area and requirement, or contact us directly on WhatsApp.

Not sure which product fits?

Tell us about your window, balcony or doorway. We’ll help you start with a free site visit.
